name: 婴儿纯棉半背衣蝴蝶衣款
description: 新生儿半背版型，偏开系带易穿脱，针织面料亲肤柔软

styleLock.backgroundSystem: snow-white ground #FAF8F0 for packshots, butter-yellow accent panels #F6E27F for benefit and close screens, pistachio-mist #E3EDD8 for comparison and variant screens, warm linen surface #EDE4D4 for the lifestyle scene
styleLock.lightingSystem: warm gentle high-key studio light, soft front-left key with wide fill, feather-soft contact shadows, no hard speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte warm linen changing-mat fabric #EDE4D4 and smooth snow-white card #FAF8F0
styleLock.iconSystem: single-weight thin-line icons in cocoa brown #453C31, used sparingly
styleLock.presentationRules: garment shown softly shaped on an invisible form or neatly folded, stable scale and gentle centering across the set
noDrift: no visible brand marks or character prints
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft newborn-underwear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of snow-white ground #FAF8F0, butter-yellow accent panel #F6E27F, pistachio-mist secondary #E3EDD8 and cocoa-brown text #453C31; warm gentle high-key lighting with a soft front-left key and feather contact shadows; rounded geometric sans-serif; single-weight thin-line icon style; clean knitwear photography mixed with minimal blank-placeholder infographic elements; stable product scale and gentle centering; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的白底主图

shots.lighting: warm gentle high-key studio light, soft front-left key with wide fill, feather contact shadow
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, product fills the frame edge to edge within the 60-70% band
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The garment softly shaped on an invisible form, straight-on eye-level view with the front facade square to the lens, sleeves relaxed and the asymmetric wrap closure visible. Warm gentle high-key studio lighting, soft front-left key with wide fill, a feather contact shadow grounding the hem. Seamless snow-white ground #FAF8F0. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame. 8K, commercial apparel e-commerce quality. Negative: no hanger hooks, no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics, no recognizable child model face, no cut-off edges.

shots.displayName: 粗硬 vs 亲肤对比痛点

shots.lighting: left panel flatter and slightly harsher, right panel warm gentle high-key
shots.whitespace: a thin clean gutter between the two panels, no extra whitespace inside each panel
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen of {product}, two matched twin panels with identical straight-on framing and distance. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Left panel: an abstract coarse scratchy knit swatch under flatter slightly harsher light, conveying stiffness against delicate skin, no person shown. Right panel: {product} folded neatly under warm gentle high-key light, conveying softness. Pistachio-mist #E3EDD8 background on both panels. Each panel occupies 50-60% of its half. Thin clean gutter between panels. Negative: no real model or skin close-up, no fabricated test data or statistics, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：panel-01 黄色半背衣挂拍卖点图，含粉/蓝两色叠放与外锁边工艺字样；panel-02 蓝色挂拍场景图加产品信息表（货号/颜色/尺码/面料/季节与厚薄柔软弹力版型选项）及洗涤说明图标；panel-03 尺码线稿表（衣长/肩宽/袖长/胸围等列）与外侧锁边工艺内外侧对比图；panel-04 面料微距加透气/亲肤/舒适/环保四图标与黄色挂拍颜色展示；panel-05 蓝/粉两色挂拍颜色展示；panel-06 领口与偏开按扣微距；panel-07 系带与袖口微距（袖口外翻可当防护手套的表述）；panel-08 半背后幅平铺图。品类判定：品名为半背衣，尺码为新生儿号型量级，面料为贴身精梳棉针织，页利益点均围绕亲肤/贴身/防护，属贴身睡衣家居类而非外穿童装，故判为内衣家居服/儿童内衣而非母婴/童装。已剥离：原品牌与织造角标、中英文标语、货号与尺码表全部实测数值、洗涤温度数值、四枚功效式图标语义、原花印图案（保留结构位描述）、假花/藤篮/玩偶等原道具组合；产品一律以 {product} 占位，原文数值一律改 {callout_n} 或空白占位；儿童件不出现可辨识童模面容。与近似模版差异：①色板全新——雪白 #FAF8F0/奶油黄油 #F6E27F/淡开心果 #E3EDD8/可可棕 #453C31 均未出现在儿童内衣与母婴童装各套中，原片黄底改用独占的奶油黄油而非库内已占用的明黄/琥珀系；②背景体系不同——以亚麻换衣垫 #EDE4D4 生活面 + 暖象牙板 #F8F4E8 信息面构成，弃用库内的云朵纹、天空蓝、雾石膏、鹅卵石纸面与剪贴卡片体系；③道具不同——卷筒纱巾与浅口水草托盘、空白圆角卡片与空尺寸线，不复用库内的绿枝蓝杯、棉铃、木衣架独用、毛绒玩具或帆布鞋收纳盒；④机位体系不同——以「侧位微距 + 90 度俯拍背面版型 + 略低于衣身轻上仰的组合收口」为节奏核心，区别于库内高频的 dead-front/matched-panel 序列；⑤角色序列不同——HERO>HERO>PAIN_POINT>SCENE>DETAIL>DETAIL>VARIANT>CTA，痛点屏用粗硬针织抽象对比而非真肤/人像，收口用多件堆叠囤货而非优惠按钮版式。
